subject: Request: freeze purge + rollback playbook + KMS escrow details
messages:
From: Claire Huang <legal@clearwellhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention ask — please freeze purge and confirm rollback option

Hi Olga,

We need to request an immediate temporary freeze on the scheduled backup purge for our account (Clearwell Health). Our legal team has flagged several records under active discovery and they asked for confirmation that Redwood can provide a reliable rollback path if we need to restore snapshots and logs.

High-level asks:
- Pause any automated purge jobs affecting Clearwell snapshots and log KV eviction for the next 7 days.
- Confirm whether Redwood can perform a rollback to a snapshot taken in the last 60 days and the approximate RTO/RPO.
- Clarify the KMS escrow behavior if we choose to roll back across regions (we have users in APAC and EU).
- Confirm whether any subprocessors (specifically DataHarbor Ltd.) will be involved in a rollback and whether they already hold copies of the affected snapshots.

I've attached our annotated DPA with two proposed edits (section 4.2 and new clause about temporary forensic holds). Procurement copied for DocuSign follow-up.

We appreciate an acknowledgement on this by EOD PDT.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Deputy GC, Clearwell Health
legal@clearwellhealth.com

Attachment: Clearwell_DPA_annotated.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Claire Huang <legal@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention ask — please freeze purge and confirm rollback option

Claire — thanks for the clear note and the annotated DPA. Acknowledged and we can start immediate steps.

Short answer to your asks:
- We will pause scheduled purge jobs for Clearwell (snapshots + KV log eviction) for 48 hours immediately and begin the fast-escrow review to scope a longer hold if needed.
- Redwood supports rollbacks to snapshots within the last 90 days; for a 60-day snapshot we expect an RTO of ~6-18 hours depending on the size and whether cross-region transfer is required. RPO is snapshot-consistent at the snapshot timestamp.
- KMS escrow: we do not automatically escrow customer keys. For this scenario we can enable an escrowed-wrapped key flow with HSM-backed tokens to allow cross-region key unwrap for emergency restores; this requires a short amendment (DocuSign) and a security review.
- Subprocessors: DataHarbor Ltd. is a storage subprocessor in APAC. They hold geo-replicated snapshots for performance; they will only be involved if we need to pull APAC-local copies for rollback. We'll confirm exactly which snapshots are present in their cluster.

Immediate ops plan (what we will do in the next 24 hours):
1) Hold: Set a 48h purge freeze for Clearwell.
2) Snapshot audit: Inventory snapshots and KV logs for the last 90 days and flag those within the requested 60-day window.
3) Forensic toggle: Enable short-term forensic retention (prevent tombstone sweep) on matching snapshots.
4) Escrow review: Start KMS escrow feasibility with security (Karthik) and legal for the DocuSign amendment.
5) Ops contact: Marissa will coordinate the runbook and any run-time manual restores.

I've attached an initial stub runbook for coordination. I'll follow up once Karthik and Marissa confirm KMS specifics and timeline.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: initial-rollforward-runbook-stub.txt (text, 3KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Claire Huang <legal@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention ask — please freeze purge and confirm rollback option

On Mon, Aug 11, 2025 at 12:00 PM olga_petrov@redwood.com wrote:
> Immediate ops plan (what we will do in the next 24 hours):
> 1) Hold: Set a 48h purge freeze for Clearwell.
> 2) Snapshot audit: Inventory snapshots and KV logs for the last 90 days and flag those within the requested 60-day window.

Claire — quick security notes and constraints so the team can plan:
- KMS escrow/unwrap: We operate customer-managed CMKs and a Redwood-wrapped escrow option where the unwrapping can be authorized by a quorum of security engineers + a legal attestation. For cross-region restores (APAC <-> US), we need to perform a key wrap/unwrap flow through our HSM provider. That process is audited and will add ~2–4 hours overhead to the restore window but does not block it.
- Subprocessor involvement: DataHarbor stores geo-replicas of snapshots; however, not all snapshots are retained on APAC edge nodes for the full 90 days by default. Our snapshot inventory step will confirm presence. If APAC-local rollback is required and DataHarbor must hand over data, we will request a documented export which adds an extra compliance step (we will notify you).
- Forensics toggle: We have a 'forensic hold' flag that prevents tombstone and KV trimming. It is reversible and scoped to account/snapshot IDs. Activating it now for the 60-day window will prevent permanent deletion while we finalize legal hold language.
- DocuSign amendment: Legal needs to sign an addendum to authorize Redwood to perform escrow unwraps for cross-border emergency restores. I suggest Claire route the attached annotated DPA as an addendum and procurement complete DocuSign.

I'll start the HSM workflow ticket and mark the restore preflight checklist as 'high priority'. Olga / Marissa please confirm whether we should extend the freeze beyond 48 hours pending legal sign-off — security is neutral but needs formal authorization for any KMS escrow actions.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Claire Huang <legal@clearwellhealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention ask — please freeze purge and confirm rollback option

Claire / team — operational confirmation and proposed timeline: we completed the snapshot audit and inventory this morning. Summary: 23 snapshots in the candidate 60-day window, 18 have APAC replicas (DataHarbor), 5 are US-only.

Proposed operational timeline (subject to DocuSign addendum for KMS unwrap):
- T0 (now): 48h automated purge freeze (we set this at 16:30 PDT today).
- T0+24h: Forensic hold flags applied to the 23 candidate snapshots (prevents tombstone sweep).
- T0+48h: If we do not receive signed authorization, we will require an internal escalation for any KMS unwrap; we will keep the forensic hold but will begin scheduling manual export windows (with customer approval).
- If DocuSign is signed within the freeze: initiate KMS escrow unwrap workflow and target a rolling restore (per-snapshot) with estimated per-snapshot restore window of 6–18 hours depending on size and APAC transfer. Full rollback (all 23) could take ~3–5 days to stage and execute.

Runbook highlights (attached):
- Snapshot selection and verification checklist
- KMS unwrap + HSM audit trail steps
- Subprocessor export request template for DataHarbor
- Communication checklist for legal / procurement

Next steps for Clearwell:
1) Procurement to complete DocuSign addendum (link: https://redwood.app/docusign/ABC-1234).
2) Legal to confirm whether a 60-day forensic hold is acceptable language in the DPA addendum.
3) We will provide a nightly status summary until the hold is lifted or remediation completes.

Marissa will be primary ops lead on the restore and will coordinate the export with DataHarbor if required. Please reply with any questions or if you want Redwood to extend the freeze beyond the initial 48 hours (we can do up to 14 days with a standard change window).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
